Recipe:
Dutch Oven Apple-Berry Crumble Cake 4-6 Servings A VanOrman Original 12&inch; Dutch Oven
§ion;
One morning, Ransom woke up a couple of hours early, so he went out and picked a bunch of fresh wild blackberries. When he came home he started following one recipe, until he realized it took pie filling, which we didn't have. Ransom quickly improvised, and came up with this recipe, which the entire family loved!
ButterSoftened 1 Cup2 Sticks
Sugar3 Cups Eggs4 Almond Extract½ teaspoon Flour3 Cups Salt1½ teaspoons Baking Powder1½ Teaspons Apple1 Fresh Blackberries2 Cups Brown Sugar1 Cup
Cream together Butter and Sugar. Add Eggs, and Almond Extract, then beat. Add Flour, Salt and Baking Powder, then beat well. Peel and core Apple, then cut Apple into pieces approximately 1&inch; &by; ¼&inch; &by; ¼&inch;. Add Apple pieces to batter and mix well. Add Blackberries and gently mix. Pour into Dutch Oven and smooth top. Sprinkle Brown Sugar evenly over top. Cook from top and bottom evenly until toothpick inserted comes away clean.
